kitDescription: Frima (Treasure) is an Iron SR Supporter whose charged sniper shots stack a Sleepy debuff on the boss, shaving its DEF by 4% per stack up to five stacks. Once the boss is fully drowsy, six more full-charge hits flip Frima into Wake Up, a 10-second self state that makes her normal shots deal true damage and re-arms on a rolling cycle. While Wake Up is live, her full-charge attacks also hand the whole team a 28.16% True Damage buff, and her burst adds a much larger 49.97% True Damage buff on top. Her burst itself is a modest single nuke at 101.66% of her attack against the toughest enemies, plus a second 9.86% DEF shred. The remaining kit lines are party Max HP buffs that help survival but deal no damage.

gotchas.summary: Same-weapon trueNormals flavor swaps skip the SR bolt-recovery cycle (sim.ts:3566-3573, chisato/takina exemption), so Frima fires at 60f (1.0s) during Wake Up vs 82f (1.37s) outside it — her true window runs ~27% more shots than her real cadence.
gotchas.evidence: Kit prose implies Wake Up changes only the flavor of her normal attacks; driver caveat 2 documents the artifact with the engine-core recipe; pre-existing engine behavior shipped by takina/chisato/laplace, not an encoding choice.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Engine-core: extend the bolt-recovery rule to same-weapon flavor swaps, then re-grade frima (and re-check takina/chisato/laplace). Needs no per-unit fudge.

verdictRationale: No undocumented divergence exists anywhere in the kit: 4 lines FAITHFUL (Wake Up, both True Damage buffs, the burst nuke) and 4 DOCUMENTED_GAP (both DEF-downs, both Max HP buffs), each gap carried verbatim with a formula-cited reason that matches the SSOT — boss DEF is a fixed config constant with no debuff channel and a negligible (~0.02%) ceiling, and ally Max HP grants have no engine reader per the e3 rule; routing either through damageTakenPct would have been the exact nearest-wrong over-credit S2b named, and the blind S6 fell into both traps while flagging them itself. The load-bearing encodings are independently converged (S6 matches the driver block-for-block on 28.16/49.97/101.66/count-6, and S5's greens agree on magnitude and gate timing), while every S5 red is classified as either the adjudicated unmodeled dispositions or blind-side artifacts (wrong event field, null-vs-undefined, invalid override shape, guessed gate field) — no red survives triage as a driver gotcha. Discrimination is real: the driver suite pairs every load-bearing assertion with a counterfactual that provably fails (count:1, ungated, self-only, compound no-Wake-Up, true-flavored nuke), including a live Wake Up gate in the fixture and byte-exact non-true negative controls. The one real residual is the pre-existing engine artifact that flavor swaps skip SR bolt recovery (~27% faster in-window cadence) — documented with an engine-core recipe, low severity, not ship-blocking; the hit-6-vs-hit-11 onset reading is adjudicated (datamine + phrasing convention + blind convergence on 6) with a measurement recipe flagged. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the Wake Up onset count (popup-read FC-count-to-Wake-Up-icon) and the treasure-prose SSOT choice over the datamine base-kit tables, since every agent here read the same prose.
